name: What is the process for initiating a sell-leaseback with Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for initiating a sell-leaseback with Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution?

acceptedAnswer.text: To initiate a sell-leaseback, you would first contact Kelby Contreras to discuss your property and financial goals. We would then assess your home's market value and connect you with potential investors or buyers interested in sale-leaseback arrangements in your area, such as Palm Beach County or Orange County. The process clarity involves an initial consultation, property evaluation, offer presentation, and then negotiation of both the sale and the subsequent lease terms, ensuring all details meet your needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start with a consultation to assess your property and goals, followed by property evaluation, offer presentation, and negotiation of sale and lease terms.
